name: ai-coach
description: AI Coach — harness your team. A coach for using Claude Code well, one focus per release.

plugins.name: ai-coach-core
plugins.description: The engine every AI Coach plugin runs on: session memory, hooks, secrets guard, and the coached session brief.

plugins.name: memory-coach
plugins.description: Memory you can search and check the health of, conclusions you can hand to a teammate, the roster that names who wrote them, and trust you keep private: /recall, /debrief, /handoff, /roster.

plugins.name: prompt-coach
plugins.description: Write prompts that land, see which habits actually cost you time, and brief a context that cannot ask you a follow-up: /prompt, /prompt-stats, /dispatch.

plugins.name: security-coach
plugins.description: Injection defense on every fetch, OWASP-grounded audits, and pentest triage: /scan, /audit, /triage.

plugins.name: harness-coach
plugins.description: The harness itself: detect, pick and install the partner tools that pair well with Claude Code, and itemize what is filling this session — /partners, /context.

plugins.name: investigation-coach
plugins.description: Onboard anyone onto the project: generated docs, an architecture map you can open in Obsidian or edit in draw.io, and study material — /onboard, /map, /study.

plugins.name: atlas-coach
plugins.description: Everything outside the repo: verified web research with an adversarial claim gate, documents-in-markdown-out ingestion, competitor and industry analysis, and documentation translated into your idiom — /research, /ingest, /market, /translate.

plugins.name: strategy-coach
plugins.description: Document what the business is and specify what comes next: an Obsidian vault of actors, processes and rules mapped to the code that implements them, and feature specs with a checkable definition of done — /blueprint, /feature. Inward-facing; competitors and industry rules moved to atlas-coach.

plugins.name: analysis-coach
plugins.description: The business-analyst half of building software: elicit requirements nobody can argue about later, turn data into an analysis that has already been argued with, and write the version an executive actually reads — /elicit, /insight, /story.

plugins.name: ai-coach
plugins.description: Install this one. Pulls in the engine and every coach released so far, plus /start, /wrap and /sitrep — the sequences that span the coaches, typed once.
